⌈If development error detection is enabled:
TcpIp_TxConfirmation() shall
check if the parameter TxPduId is valid.
If the check fails, TcpIp_TxCon-
firmation() shall refuse the request and raise the development error code
TCPIP_E_INVALID_PDU_SDU_ID instead.⌋
